say:1:1530132401:0.text: My companion... she was a brave warrior.
say:1:1530132401:0.source_cn: 我的同伴，一个英勇的战士……
say:1:1530132401:0.male: My companion... she was a brave warrior.
say:1:1530132401:0.female: My companion... she was a brave warrior.

say:2:1530132402:0.text: I warned her the Halians are cunning, always ganging up on the few. I told her I had a way to deal with it, that she shouldn't get involved.
say:2:1530132402:0.source_cn: 我明明和她说过，呼临人狡诈，喜欢以多胜少，但我有办法解...
say:2:1530132402:0.male: I warned her the Halians are cunning, always ganging up on the few. I told her I had a way to deal with it, that she shouldn't get involved.
say:2:1530132402:0.female: I warned her the Halians are cunning, always ganging up on the few. I told her I had a way to deal with it, that she shouldn't get involved.

say:3:1530132403:0.text: But she jumped in anyway, blocking the weapons they hurled at me...
say:3:1530132403:0.source_cn: 但她还是跳出来，替我挡住了那群人投来的武器……
say:3:1530132403:0.male: But she jumped in anyway, blocking the weapons they hurled at me...
say:3:1530132403:0.female: But she jumped in anyway, blocking the weapons they hurled at me...

say:4:1530132404:0.text: She... she died because of me...
say:4:1530132404:0.male: She... she died because of me...
say:4:1530132404:0.female: She... she died because of me...
